findings.summary: CSS classes handling layout grids (.searchLayout, .mapWorkspace, .detailGallery) improperly hardcode 'direction: ltr' to force visual ordering of columns. In an RTL Arabic interface, the container should remain RTL, and columns should either flow naturally from right-to-left or utilize the 'order' property for specific visual placements. Forcing LTR on the container and reverting to RTL on children breaks semantic alignment and standard accessibility expectations.

RTL Logical Property Violation: Mobile media query (@media max-width: 560px) applies physical property 'left: 12px' to '.heroCaption', conflicting with base RTL logical properties ('inset-inline-start'). This should be updated to use logical inset properties to maintain exact layout mirroring bounds.
